prompt: How long can I keep cooked rice before eating it?
answer: Cool the cooked rice quickly and refrigerate it within one hour of cooking. Eat refrigerated rice within one day. When you reheat rice, heat it until it is steaming hot all the way through. Do not reheat rice more than once. Rice is a good source of energy.
